<!-- pr-reviewer: 64bace673a9f4da5b279303f2169e100c659ddae -->
Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge (the PR stays a draft: the coordinator flags it ready before the merge).

## What looks good

- The fix is small and in the UI watch only. `resolve` in `crates/ui/src/model_link_watch.rs` uses `Path` APIs (`parent`, `is_relative`, `join`). It has no string concatenation, so it works on Windows and Linux.
- An absolute link and a project that is not saved give the same path as before.
- A re-import keeps the link text (`state.rs` `finish_import`), so the saved file keeps a relative link and the project stays movable. The test checks this (`link_text == "part.stl"`).
- A `..` or symlink in a link is joined and read as before. Only the base folder changes. The match in `linked_to` compares the same resolved path that the watch queued, so it is not made worse.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the changed code. `expect` appears only in the test helper `relink`.
- The tests do not change the working directory. They assert that `part.stl` is not in it. `catalog_render.rs` and the catalog files are unchanged. No snapshot PNG changed.
- The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #3686`. The PR changes no process file.

## Results merged with main

Locally, in a trial merge of the PR head with origin/main 82db54282 (clean merge, no conflict). The merged tree differs from main only in the three PR files.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render` | 2 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (`catalog_cases_open_and_frame_cleanly` ok) |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib model_link` | 5 passed, 0 failed (both new tests ok) |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib` | 1521 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No runner was used.

## Heavy lanes

None run. The rule in force is no heavy lane below P1, and this is a P2 UI change.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` has 5077 lines. The PR adds about 10 lines to `finish_import`. A split is a follow-up.
- A relative link is read against the folder of the open project. If the user saves the project to a different folder (Save As), the relative link then points to a different folder. This is the same rule as for any relative path. It is outside this fix.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
